summary: SWOT analysis of 5 disk space optimization strategies for the FaceSwap pipeline, grounded in real-world measurements (5,744 frames = 952 MB for an 86-second video). Covers: (1) Sliding Window Batched Processing, (2) FFmpeg Pipe Streaming, (3) Selective-Only Extraction, (4) JPEG Intermediate Format, and (5) Hybrid Concat Encoding. Each strategy includes strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats, implementation complexity, and estimated disk savings.
